Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Plumbing and HVAC Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Plumbing and HVAC Services specializes in providing high-quality plumbing and HVAC installation, maintenance, and repair services for residential and small commercial clients. Our operations include routine plumbing repairs, complete HVAC system installations, and regular preventive maintenance to ensure optimal performance and energy efficiency. We employ licensed and certified technicians dedicated to safety and compliance with local building codes. Our focus on environmentally friendly practices includes the phasing out of ozone-depleting refrigerants in accordance with EPA regulations, alongside our commitment to using modern, energy-efficient systems. We maintain a clean safety record and prioritize ongoing staff training to uphold industry standards and best practices in all projects.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, during routine maintenance at a residential property, a technician accidentally caused a minor water leak due to improper valve handling. The leak resulted in damage to the flooring and wall of the client’s bathroom. The repair costs were estimated at $1,500. The claim has been settled, and all repairs were completed by April 1, 2023. Status: Closed.
